name: scene-picking-visual
description: Redesign P2: hovering and clicking scene entities (raycaster over terrain + entity meshes). Hover a placed building — the debounced hover tag should show its name and HP; click it — a selection ring should appear on the ground and the bottom selection bar should show Upgrade/Move/Demolish; Esc deselects — both disappear; hovering bare terrain shows tile coordinates and 'no survey data'. Also covers the employee side of the same picker (parity with the retired playtest 'scene-picking' definition): selecting a hired employee by clicking them in the 3D scene (clickEntity, not a panel row) and opening their crew detail via the selection bar's DETAIL action.

steps.description: Setup: a fresh site with open ground around the origin
Setup: place a building at a known tile — its footprint centre (11, 11) is the click target
Frame the building dead-centre, then hover it — the tag should appear once the 60ms debounce settles, showing the building's name and HP
Click the building — a dashed selection ring appears on the ground and the bottom selection bar shows Upgrade/Move/Demolish

expect.note: waitForSelector above only proved the button exists in the DOM; usable proves it is genuinely clickable, not covered/hidden

steps.description: Esc deselects — the ring and the selection bar both disappear

expect.note: Esc hides the selection bar entirely, so its buttons must no longer be reachable

steps.description: Hover bare terrain away from the building — the tag shows tile coordinates and 'no survey data' (nothing has surveyed this column)
Setup for the employee side of the picker: hire a driller (parity with the retired playtest 'scene-picking' definition)

expect.note: HIRING_COSTS.driller is 1000 (balance.ts); cash was 42000 after the management_office purchase above

steps.description: Click the hired driller in the 3D scene (clickEntity by kind+id, not a panel row) — the selection bar should show Detail/Dispatch Here/Train for this employee

expect.note: a dashed selection ring should appear on the ground and the bottom selection bar should show Detail/Dispatch Here/Train for the clicked employee

steps.description: Open the crew detail from the selection bar's DETAIL action — must expand this exact employee's row, not just bring the panel to the front

expect.note: DETAIL must open the Crew panel with this exact employee's row expanded

steps.description: Close the selection bar — its own close (x) button is the only one of the bar's buttons without a data-action

expect.note: closing the selection bar must make its actions unreachable again, same invariant as the Esc-deselects building check above
